disclaimer: Platform-informed screening simulation based on public Greenhouse documentation. This is not a Greenhouse score and does not reproduce any employer's configuration.
emphasis: separation of resume screening from interview scorecards

scenarios.title: Manual recruiter review in Application Review
scenarios.description: Application Review is the first stage; a recruiter views documents and answers and advances or rejects.

scenarios.title: Review using structured application criteria
scenarios.description: Recruiters may filter by exact keywords, tags and custom fields; retrieval affects visibility but is not rejection.

scenarios.title: Employer-configured eligibility screening
scenarios.description: On applicable tiers, configured answers to job-post questions can auto-tag, auto-advance or auto-reject.
emphasis: truthful, exact answers to eligibility questions

scenarios.title: Optional Talent Matching (Real Talent add-on)
scenarios.description: If licensed and enabled, explained AI matching against recruiter-calibrated criteria supports prioritisation; it cannot advance or reject.
emphasis: evidence for calibrated skills, titles, experience

scenarios.title: Interview-stage scorecard preparation
scenarios.description: Scorecards capture human interview feedback against predetermined attributes; they are not resume screening.
